author: PI/OpenAI
selection: Development: first two birth-country groups in TwoHopFact novel-author-birthcntry file order with at least two distinct authors, first two distinct authors per group. New native-chat prompts; unseen concepts/prior source-query status unproven. No model-output selection or first-hop filter. Modern-country wording replaces anachronistic country interpretation; Wu Cheng'en is the traditional attribution. Same-country shortcuts remain possible. All four cases retained; v5 untouched.
alias_scope: Surnames catch spoken full names conservatively under the existing whole-word scorer. Cao or Wu alone and short token prefixes are not confirmed person identities; semantic review must distinguish lexical matches from identification. No ranking or mask changes.
